import importlib.util, zipfile, tarfile, gzip, zlib, lzma, hashlib, collections, math, struct, re
p='inputs/chall/unknown.data'; b=open(p,'rb').read()
print('sha256',hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'size',len(b))
for m in ('cbor2','cbor','msgpack','cryptography','asn1crypto'):
 print('module',m, bool(importlib.util.find_spec(m)))
print('zip_is_file',zipfile.is_zipfile(p))
for sig in (b'PK\x03\x04',b'PK\x05\x06',b'PK\x07\x08',b'SQLite format 3\x00',b'\x1f\x8b',b'7z\xbc\xaf\x27\x1c',b'Rar!\x1a\x07',b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'):
 print('sig',sig.hex(),[m.start() for m in re.finditer(re.escape(sig),b)])
# byte entropy
freq=collections.Counter(b); H=-sum((n/len(b))*math.log2(n/len(b)) for n in freq.values())
print('entropy_bits_per_byte',H,'unique_bytes',len(freq))
# count zero bytes and string occurrence offsets
print('zero_bytes',freq.get(0,0),'UTF16_name_positions',[m.start() for m in re.finditer('Carmine Falcone.zip'.encode('utf-16le'),b)])
try:
 import cbor2
 x=cbor2.loads(b)
 print('cbor2 decoded type',type(x).__name__, 'repr',repr(x)[:5000])
except Exception as e: print('cbor2 decode error',type(e).__name__,str(e))
try:
 import msgpack
 x=msgpack.unpackb(b,raw=False)
 print('msgpack decoded type',type(x).__name__, 'repr',repr(x)[:5000])
except Exception as e: print('msgpack decode error',type(e).__name__,str(e))
PY
